excerpts: 3-page Rural Hospital Closure and Conversion Website Update (NC Rural Health Research Program; author Pink, George H; created 2023-10-17): October 2023 REH split - complete closures and conversions to other providers stay on closures site; REH conversions move to a new REH site. Closure definition changed from cessation-of-inpatient / CMS-hospital-definition to no-longer-meets-CMS-definition-of-hospital-OR-REH. Recount on 10-5/10-6-2023: 201 (=102 complete + 89 converted + 10 REH) restated to 191 (+ 10 REH reported separately); summing both sites reconstructs the inpatient-cessation series. Scenario table for 5 REH transitions (open->REH, closed->REH, REH closes, REH->urgent care, REH->acute). CMS hospital/REH definitions cited with cms.gov sources (referenced, not fetched).
